sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Echtach is an obscure Irish heroine or goddess. She haunts east county Clare as a spectral owl. Her sister was Echthge, the cannibal woman of the same region. It is unclear whether Echtach matches the similar Eachtach. Some sources call Echtach Echthge's rival rather than her sister.

okr.objective: Describe Echtach as an obscure owl goddess of east county Clare.
